summary: First full QA pass on CorpZo Debt CRM. Backend: 53 pytest cases across auth, dashboard, leads (CRUD+convert), clients 360, cases, sandbox bureau, document upload/version/download, lenders+suggest, applications, lender queries, sanctions, disbursements (auto incentive/CP accrual), mandate lifecycle, invoices+payments, employees/incentives/CP/tasks, reports, audit, search, integrations — all green AFTER fixing a blocking ObjectId serialization defect that made every POST endpoint return 500. Frontend: verified login page, cookie session, dashboard KPIs/funnel/top-lenders/invoice summary, leads list+filters+create+detail (activity log, stage change), global search, cases list + full case working flow (pull sandbox bureau -> upload document -> create application -> record sanction -> record disbursement with stage auto-transitions), client 360 tabs, invoices Mark Paid -> /api/payments, admin users role change persistence, reports, audit, integrations, settings and all 25 sidebar nav items. Test data created during the run was cleaned up (leads=30, clients=10, cases=15 restored).

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: handlers did `await db.X.insert_one(doc); return doc` — Motor mutates doc with a BSON ObjectId `_id`, so FastAPI serialization raised ValueError('ObjectId' object is not iterable) => HTTP 500 on every create. Nothing could be created via API or UI. Tester added `doc.pop('_id', None)` after each insert_one and a `_sanitize()` helper in audit() (nested before/after payloads also leaked ObjectId and broke GET /api/audit-logs with 500). Recommend replacing with Pydantic response_model / a shared insert helper so this cannot regress.
500 KeyError 'due_date' when due_date is not supplied (server.py create_task uses body['due_date']). Should be optional or return 422.
500 KeyError 'amount' / 'client_uid' when fields are missing. No validation layer.

minor.issue: No Pydantic request models — raw `await request.json()` with body['key'] access. Missing/invalid fields produce 500 instead of 422. models.py exists but is unused by routes.
PATCH does $set of (nearly) the whole request body; a client can overwrite protected keys (case_uid, client_uid, created_at). Whitelist allowed fields as done in PATCH /api/documents.

Invoice 'paid' status is computed against invoice.amount only; gst_pct/tds_pct are stored but never applied, so a payment of the base amount marks a GST invoice fully paid. No total_amount field is exposed.
Aggregation results are returned with the raw Mongo `_id` key as the stage name; API contract should use `stage`.

No documents, bureau_checks, lender_queries or assessments are seeded, and every seeded mandate is created with status='active'. Fresh env therefore shows empty Documents/Bureau/Queries pages and the Mandates 'Advance' lifecycle button never renders.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Advance' button never available because all 15 seeded mandates are status='active' — draft->internal_approval->sent->signed->verified->active flow cannot be exercised in UI (verified via API instead). Needs seeded mandates in earlier statuses.
'DOC COMPLETENESS' stays 0% even after 3 documents (one marked valid) are attached to the case — metric appears hardcoded/not computed.
Upload has no category/doc_type picker; every upload is stored as category 'KYC' with doc_type 'Auto', which also defeats the backend version chain (per client+case+doc_type).
Sub-title renders dangling separators ('· ,') when company/city are empty.
'Configure →' links on every integration row are non-functional placeholders (no navigation/dialog).

Interactive elements without data-testid: CaseDetail tab triggers, 'New application'/'Apply'/'Sanction'/'Disburse' buttons and their dialog inputs & save buttons, Invoices 'Mark Paid', Mandates 'Advance', AdminUsers role select, Clients/Applications/Sanctions/Disbursements table rows, Reports tables. Tests had to fall back to role/text selectors.

issues: Render as bare tables with no data and no empty-state illustration/CTA on a fresh environment
Tables paint headers before data resolves with no loading skeleton (looks broken for ~1s)

action_items: Replace the tester's `doc.pop('_id')` band-aid with Pydantic response models / a shared insert-and-return helper so ObjectId can never leak again
Add Pydantic request models (models.py is unused) — POST /api/tasks (due_date) and POST /api/invoices (amount, client_uid) currently 500 on missing fields
Compute invoice total with gst_pct/tds_pct and base payment status on that total; expose total_amount
Seed documents, bureau checks, lender queries and mandates in non-active statuses so Documents/Bureau/Queries/Mandates UI flows are demonstrable
Add category/doc_type selection to the case document upload
Return `stage` instead of `_id` from dashboard funnel and reports/pipeline aggregations
Add data-testid to CaseDetail tabs, application/sanction/disbursement dialogs+buttons, Invoices Mark Paid, Mandates Advance, AdminUsers role select and remaining table rows
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1300+ lines with 60+ routes in one file — split into routers (leads, cases, credit, lending, commercials, admin)
Every handler parses `await request.json()` and indexes required keys directly — no validation, no 4xx errors; models.py (524 lines) is dead code
audit() persisted raw pre/post documents containing BSON ObjectId, permanently poisoning GET /api/audit-logs (one stored record had to be repaired in Mongo)
Repeated list/insert boilerplate across handlers; extract a generic CRUD helper (DRY)

success_rate.backend: 100% (53/53 after tester ObjectId fix; 0% of POST endpoints worked before it)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all pages/nav render and core flows pass; mandate advance flow untestable, doc-completeness metric wrong)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so cross-class state must go through the session fixtures `ent`/`application` in conftest.py, never module globals). After a run, execute `mongosh test_database /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.js` to purge TEST_QA data. Not yet retested: mandate status-advance UI (needs non-active seeded mandates), Assessments page write flows, Queries page write flows, mobile/tablet responsiveness, notifications button.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the blocking 500s: PyMongo/Motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict by injecting the generated BSON ObjectId under '_id'. Handlers returned that same dict, so FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed with ValueError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"). Reproduction: POST /api/leads with a valid body -> 500 (log: fastapi/encoders.py line 330). Mitigation applied: pop '_id' immediately after every insert_one and sanitize audit before/after payloads recursively; one already-persisted audit_logs document containing an ObjectId was repaired so GET /api/audit-logs stopped returning 500.
